Purpose: To tell the runtime, per toolchain, which files define checks and which locations hold caches, so
that the protected set can be built.
Caller and time: The engine at launch, when it derives the check manifest and the protected set; the doctor.
Inputs: A profile per toolchain: patterns for files that define checks, cache locations, user-level
configuration files, suppression markers, the executables to pin, seed paths for worker trees, and
per worker the environment that moves a cache which is unsafe for several writers.
Outputs: The protected set of a phase and the pins of its executables.
Errors: A profile that does not validate is refused at load with a doctor finding.
Guarantees of the core: A toolchain without a profile has the basic protection only, and the doctor and the `[LOOP]` line
Guarantees of an implementation: A profile is data. It names no command to run, with one exception: one fixed argument list of
a pinned executable by which the effective configuration of the toolchain is read.
Failure of an implementation: A refused profile is treated as absent.
Unknown-value rule: An unknown field is ignored with a finding. A toolchain the product does not detect has no profile.
Wave 1 implementations: Shipped profiles for the toolchains the product detects. Profiles of the consumer in user
